## Wrap-up summary

**Open item resolved — p-518 edge-streaming share:** My session notes carried a worry that this share might be a dead link because the CMS publish "slipped in staging." On review, that memory was misleading. The publish record and campaign brief both show the safeguards worked exactly as designed: the blog was published at 10:00 UTC, the content team explicitly confirmed it live (handoff CONTENT-441), and my share went out 90 minutes later at 11:30 UTC. The staging slips happened *before* publish and don't affect the live link. This is the inverse of the June incident (share-before-publish), so there was nothing to clean up — the post stays live. I closed the item in `ops/session-notes.md` with that reasoning so the next shift doesn't re-investigate it.

**Rest of the account:** The only other @openclaw post on the timeline is the older April 1 Agent SDK v2.0 post — normal organic content, nothing flagged against it, and the June incident in my notes is already marked resolved. No other open items.

**State left for next shift:** Timeline is consistent — two live @openclaw posts, both intentional, no dead-link exposure. The notes file is updated but I've left it uncommitted; say the word if you want me to commit it as part of the handoff (previous shifts did commit their notes).
